title: Bench our-way-prod GPS flake is grader-search variance plus terminate exit-code artifact not a daemon crash evidence chunk 3
summary: The delivery-clip fix from commit 00806352 (full_content=1 -> fuller content field, lib/search/context-compiler.js) WORKS and is necessary (864-char GPS chunk reaches the answerer un-clipped when retrieved), but it is downstream of the retrieval-variance root cause. The embed sidecar is healthy (MiniLM loads 0.3s from the shared model cache) and never actually times out in these runs. The embedded daemon's judge backend resolves to the agentic-cli claude provider (DEFAULT_PROVIDER_ID=claude, kind agentic-cli; isAuthed via CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN loaded from .env.local by loadEnvForClaude) and spawns claude.exe per round (~80-140s); when the worktree/env lacks the token the drain cleanly skips no_backend (judged=0, judge_idle) which is the OTHER way an empty answer arises.
